0.original: Qhoterl Pasol has a passion for rations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Deliver the requested items to Qhoterl Pasol.

48.original: Once we descend into the caverns, you'll appreciate that it isn't always practical to return to the surface to satisfy every bodily whim.

49.original: In light of this, I provide our workers with some rations to take with them, and I'd be grateful if you could assist me by obtaining an ingredient.

50.original: Scorpions are what I require─three ought to do nicely. You will find them if you search in the Husk.

51.original: Wild berries are what I require─three handfuls ought to do nicely. You will find them growing in the Husk.

52.original: A piranha is what I require─just one ought to do nicely. You will find them swimming in the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta, but you'll need to be handy with a spear.

53.original: As they say, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, one can't work on an empty stomach─much less when one isn't down in the caverns. So please, bring me the ingredient.

54.original: In order to proceed with this quest, you must first complete the quest “A New Fishing Ex-spear-ience” and unlock spearfishing.

55.original: That's three scorpions I require, good <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. You will find them if you search in the Husk.

56.original: That's three handfuls of wild berries I require, good <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. You will find them growing in the Husk.

57.original: That's a piranha I require, good <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. You will find them swimming in the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta.

58.original: Welcome back, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Did your procurement efforts meet with success?

59.original: Oho, such lively scorpions these are! And this one almost stung me, the cheeky fellow! But it won't be stinging anyone after I've fried it up to a crisp, oh no.

60.original: Oho, such plump, juicy berries these are! I shall press them to make invigorating drinks for our workers in the event they can't readily find groundwater.

61.original: Oho, such a lively piranha this is! And it almost took a bite out of me, the cheeky fellow! But it won't be biting anyone after I've cleaned out its guts and hung it up to dry, oh no.

62.original: With that, I shall set about the preparations at once. My thanks for your kind assistance, good <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>!
